title: Site Model — launchd unit-writers (macOS adapter)
description: The launchd instance of generic unit-writers (guide §3 / map §4.1, D36): exactly one writer per unit-name prefix or exact reverse-DNS label. Overlapping prefixes or an exact label under a prefix is a lint failure. On systemd the goal file's own unit-writer map takes exact names, template keys and cfengine-only prefixes, and a unit-package map claims a Debian package's units (schema v5); this file is the launchd Site Model adapter.

contract_version.description: 2 since 2026-11-24 (issue #99): adds exact `label` entries (mutually exclusive with `prefix`) and `writer: "tendcf-install"` on exact `label` entries only (pinned to `org.tendcf.execd` by lint). Exact pin (`const`), matching services.schema.json.

domain.description: The launchd label namespace, as a domain of device state (D16(d)). Comprehensive means: any loaded launchd job that is absent from the domain's description is reported as an extra entry (a label matching no declared prefix or exact label is how a job is absent here).

prefix.description: Reverse-DNS label prefix ending in `.*`, e.g. `com.tendcf.example.*`. Mutually exclusive with `label`. tools/schema_lint.py additionally rejects a prefix nested inside another or overlapping an exact `label` — two writers over one namespace is exactly the hazard this file exists to prevent.

label.description: Exact reverse-DNS launchd label, e.g. `org.tendcf.execd`. Mutually exclusive with `prefix`. Required for `writer: "tendcf-install"` (which tools/schema_lint.py pins to `org.tendcf.execd`).

writer.description: The single tool permitted to write labels under this prefix or exact label. `tendcf-install` is permitted only on an exact `label` entry (never a `prefix`) and is pinned to `org.tendcf.execd` by lint.

repo.description: Where that writer's definition lives, when it is ours.
